help_page.team_available: Our team is here to help you 24/7

q1.question: How does the lesson system work?
q1.answer: Lessons are organized by adventures, sagas and topics. Complete each lesson to earn points and unlock the next ones. Your progress is saved automatically.

q2.question: Do games count toward my progress?
q2.answer: Yes! Games let you practice financial concepts in a fun way and also accumulate experience points on your profile.

q3.question: How can I change my password?
q3.answer: Go to Settings → Security → Change password. If you signed in with Google or Discord, this option won't be available since your account is linked to those providers.

q4.question: Can I use LittleFounders in another language?
q4.answer: Yes! You can switch between Spanish and English at any time from Settings → Language, or directly from the profile menu.
